item.title: php86: 8.6.0RC4 -> 8.6.0
item.description:
PHP 8.6.0 GA: https://www.php.net/releases/8_6_0.php Changes: https://github.com/php/php-src/blob/php-8.6.0/NEWS

php86 now uses the default php.net/distributions tarball like the other PHP versions, so the pre-release phpSrc = fetchurl { ... } override and the now-unused fetchurl argument are removed (mkPhp keeps its phpSrc option for the next pre-release cycle).

The hash matches the official sha256 in the php.net releases JSON, and the tarball's GPG signature (Matteo Beccati, 016895DE9A475111D537A6E69134FF30BC5A99B5) verifies against php-keyring.gpg.

Compared to RC4, this also brings the bundled uriparser 1.0.3 (CVE-2026-48841, from RC5) and the security fixes released today:

16 security advisories fixed in 8.6.0 (7 critical)
  • GHSA-2fjv-p558-g82m / CVE-2026-129182 (critical)
  • GHSA-658j-r8rw-q6mx / CVE-2026-115560 (critical)
  • GHSA-8mjj-2r7p-4hg2 / CVE-2026-129474 (critical)
  • GHSA-fm2m-fjf5-v3cp / CVE-2026-126714 (critical)
  • GHSA-g3vh-838c-65v7 / CVE-2026-129481 (critical)
  • GHSA-gr4f-wgx5-jpfv / CVE-2026-129496 (critical)
  • GHSA-qc49-hpvq-g2w6 / CVE-2026-129289 (critical)
  • GHSA-68fq-fh7h-f8gr / CVE-2026-128090 (high)
  • GHSA-f6gg-rchx-xw8j / CVE-2026-128064 (high)
  • GHSA-mmf9-xm3v-hg2x / CVE-2026-127960 (high)
  • GHSA-3mg3-cr28-46gc / CVE-2026-129292 (medium)
  • GHSA-4646-p932-gw34 / CVE-2026-129506 (medium)
  • GHSA-5j3f-64r7-f564 / CVE-2026-129538 (medium)
  • GHSA-mg3p-mxj9-g2mm / CVE-2026-129438 (medium)
  • GHSA-q23r-hr55-xmpg / CVE-2026-15353 (medium)
  • GHSA-x8r7-mg3g-74hg / CVE-2026-129501 (medium)

staging-26.11 already exists; landing this before release-26.11 branches off (or backporting it) means 26.11 ships 8.6.0 rather than RC4.

AI disclosure: prepared with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), which tracked the release, verified the tarball (GPG signature + php.net checksum), made the change and ran the local builds/tests listed below. I reviewed the change and the results.

item.title: temurin-bin-27: update for CVE-2026-114938
item.description:
Pin the published Temurin 27.0.1.1+4 binaries for CVE-2026-114938.

The x86_64-linux JDK pin evaluates to the patched version. Adoptium has not published some assets, including several Alpine and macOS builds. Those assets keep their existing pins. See the upstream rollout tracker.

The source generator now keeps the fourth version component.

One pull request per Temurin version limits the rebuild impact. These sibling pull requests have the same purpose and do not depend on each other. Each one contains the same generator change, so they can merge in any order.

  • #590303
  • #590304
  • #590305
